summary: Larry Dignan / Constellation Research: Progress Software agrees to acquire Domo's AI and data platform business for $400M; Domo will remain publicly listed and change its name after the deal closes — Progress Software said it will acquire Domo's AI and data platform business for $400 million. — According to Progress Software …
